name: dynGENIE3
method_summary: dynGENIE3 fits one random-forest or extra-trees model per target to a finite-difference dynamical response with gene degradation rates, pooling independent observed time courses and optionally steady-state samples. The official Python implementation exports directed, unsigned target-normalized importance scores; its one-step derivative approximation does not produce edge-specific lags.

threading.upstream_mapping: ANDREA --threads maps to upstream nthreads=min(assigned threads, target gene count) (multiprocessing Pool over targets). Each forest has n_jobs=1 and generated entrypoint limits native math libraries to one thread per process before Python starts. Patched per-target random_state makes seed assignment independent of worker scheduling. Runtime scaling is workload-dependent and remains pending measurement.

required.usage: Exact one-to-one descriptors for every expression column. Time-series rows declare independent biological trajectories and observed coordinates, time units and sampling_design; steady-state rows have no series/time fields. Both observation types are selected from the same expression matrix; steady-state samples feed native SS_data on the identical gene axis.

optional.usage: Candidate regulator IDs passed to upstream regulators. When absent every expression gene is a candidate regulator.

progress.note: Phase progress only; upstream target logs are retained, and process-pool completion is not an incremental progress observable.

alpha.description: Upstream degradation rate per observed-time unit. from_data preserves the exact upstream data-dependent estimator; scalar or gene-row-ordered vector accepts finite rates >=0, matching implementation. Zero rates can make optional SS/OOB diagnostics undefined.

oneOf.description: Estimate degradation rates from temporal data.
Common degradation rate per observed-time unit.
One rate per primary expression gene in exact row order.

tree_method.description: Upstream forest family; no wrapper replacement of tree hyperparameters.

K.description: Candidate features per split: upstream sqrt, all, or positive integer. The compatibility patch maps sklearn legacy auto to 1.0 for all features.

oneOf.description: Positive feature count, with upstream all-feature saturation.

ntrees.description: Number of trees per target; upstream default 1000. Quality stability calculation compares all tree pairs and may be expensive.

compute_quality_scores.description: Upstream RF out-of-bag prediction correlation and RF/ET top-five stability diagnostics. Undefined diagnostics are retained as null with warnings; ET does not supply the RF prediction score.

save_models.description: Retain the upstream per-target fitted models in provenance/tree_models.joblib; model reuse requires matching pinned runtime versions.

maxcount.description: Public get_link_list export option, applied deterministically to positive non-self VIM edges at full precision; zero intentionally exports an empty network.

oneOf.description: Maximum number of ranked positive edges.

seed.description: ANDREA reproducibility extension, absent from the upstream API. Patched random_state derives a stable seed per target using SeedSequence([seed,target_index]), independently of process scheduling.

artifacts_aux.description: Full-precision VIM, resolved degradation rates and observed series, target seeds, input hashes, raw quality diagnostics, software versions and optional fitted models.
